description: Five brand-new level-1 Humans in Northshire, a dungeon party (a tank, a healer, three DPS), on Codex with GPT-6.1 Sol, with one goal: clear the Deadmines (achievement 628, earned when Edwin VanCleef dies). Levelling and gear on the way are up to them. No real time limit: a week on the clock, and each agent stops when it has the achievement.
